# Vendored: mediaremote-adapter

- Upstream: https://github.com/ungive/mediaremote-adapter
- Commit: 0e82bf1 (2026-10-17)
- License: BSD 3-Clause (see `LICENSE`)

Only the Perl script, the public header and the framework sources are copied;
the test client, CMake files and tooling are left out. The framework is built
by `Scripts/build-mediaremote-adapter.sh` during the Xcode build. Files are
unmodified; to update, copy the same paths from a newer upstream commit and
change the commit above.
